threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look puzzled when the bus driver shouts 'Get on, love!' at you. Expect a cheeky grin and a swift departure, not a tour guide!
Last night, I saw a bloke serenading the driver on the 59, while the rest of us tried to pretend we weren’t laughing.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids practicing breakdancing on the street outside my window, while the smell of fresh kebab wafted in. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You know how the BVG makes everyone lose their minds during strikes? Only in Berlin can you experience mass chaos but still see people laughing over their beer at the pub next door.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by their patience at BART delays. The annoyed huffing from transplants says it all when the train's late again.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 31 on Larkin at midnight, driver joked about 'our own late-night express'. Only in SF do you get laughter with delays and 2 a.m. riders.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they need to dress up to sip a café con leche at La Vila. But trust me, sweats and sandals are the real Gràcia vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newbie by their bewilderment at the seemingly spontaneous bike lanes that pop up overnight, blocking their paths.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: When you still ask for a flat white and don’t know what a ‘Hackney’ is in the context of a pub crawl, it’s pretty obvious.
Last night on the 68, a bloke serenaded us with a ukulele, claiming he wrote the best breakup song. Best entertainment I've had on a night ride!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy in a full tuxedo, top hat and all, waiting for the bus at Hermannplatz. Just another Tuesday in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin will you find a spontaneous party breaking out in an abandoned lot, complete with DJs and makeshift bars. It’s part of the charm.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they can tell you exactly which taco truck has the best salsas for your late-night cravings. It’s all about the late-night options.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy in a full tuxedo on the 19 Polk, juggling apples while his phone blasted Tchaikovsky. Only in the Tenderloin, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all plazas in Gràcia are for es boc! Most only know about Plaza del Sol, but try any side street for real local vibes.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still trying to figure out the 15 different ways to order a 'café con leche' at the local bar.
